title: Visualization router
description: Chooses how an answer is presented (text, table, chart, diagram, map, calculator). The internal router is the default and never leaves this server.
loadFailed: Could not load the visualization router.
model.label: Model
noProvider: Add and discover a provider in Providers above first.
noModel: No decision or chat models on this provider. Add one in Providers above.
gatewayUrl: AI Gateway URL (optional, https; replaces the account endpoint)
modelsLoaded: {count} decision models loaded into the model list.
decisionsNote: Uses the OpenRouter Decisions API (alpha, may change) with a Decision-type model such as cloudflare/clef-flash; it classifies directly, so no constraint mode applies. Requests go to openrouter.ai with its own key.
openrouterNote: Requests go to openrouter.ai with its own key. Public providers must be allowed in the server settings.
cloudflareNote: Requests go to the Workers AI OpenAI-compatible endpoint of your account (or your AI Gateway URL) with its own token. Public providers must be allowed in the server settings.
keepSaved: Leave blank to keep the saved key
typesafeNote: Requests go to api.typesafe.ai, which must be on the allowed list in the server settings.
allowRemote: Allow sending the last 4 chat messages (up to 6,000 characters each) to this router
privacyNote: Never sent: system prompts, tool output, keys. Turns using local-only sources never use an external router. If the router fails the turn shows a retryable error; there is no silent fallback.
saveFailed: Could not save the visualization router.
test.label: Test routing
test.errorInternalRouter: Select an external router to test it.
test.errorConsentRequired: Allow sending chat excerpts to this router first.
test.errorCredentialRequired: Save an API key or token first.
test.errorNetworkDenied: The endpoint is blocked by network policy or is not allow-listed.
test.errorTimeout: The provider did not respond in time.
test.errorInvalidCategory: The provider returned an answer outside the 13 categories.
test.errorModeUnsupported: The endpoint rejected both constraint modes.
unauthorized: Please sign in again to continue.
forbidden: This action is not allowed for this account.
conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload and try again.
serviceUnavailable: The service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
